definitions.explanation: Additional compensation paid to employees for work performed beyond regular working hours.

examples.japanese: {残業代|ざんぎょうだい}が{出|で}ない{会社|かいしゃ}もある。
{今月|こんげつ}は{残業代|ざんぎょうだい}がたくさん{入|はい}った。
examples.english: I received a lot of overtime pay this month.

examples.japanese: {残業代|ざんぎょうだい}を{請求|せいきゅう}するために{残業|ざんぎょう}{時間|じかん}を{記録|きろく}している。
examples.english: I'm recording my overtime hours in order to claim overtime pay.

notes:
WORK CULTURE NOTE:
In Japan, unpaid overtime (サービス{残業|ざんぎょう}) has been a significant social issue. Recent labor reforms have strengthened regulations requiring proper payment of {残業代|ざんぎょうだい}.

RELATED TERMS:
- {残業|ざんぎょう}: overtime work
- サービス{残業|ざんぎょう}: unpaid overtime
- {時間外|じかんがい}{手当|てあて}: overtime allowance (formal term)
